final_decision.text: (Final decision) Order rendered by The Honourable Mr. Justice Gibson at Ottawa on 03-DEC-2007 dismissing the application for leave ORDER: This Judge, by Order dated the 16th day of April, 2007, having denied an extension of time to file the Applicant's application for leave and for judicial review herein, filed the 15th of January, 2007, and having dismissed that application for leave and for judicial review; And this Judge, by Order dated the 6th of July, 2007, having set aside the foregoing Order for reasons given that day; And the Applicant having now been returned to Canada after having been deported to Jamaica, such return having been reported to the Court in a report by counsel for the Respondent dated the 29th of November, 2007, such report further indicating that the Applicant has, since his return to Canada, been held in detention at the Toronto West Detention Centre, and no equivalent report having been received by the Court from counsel for the Applicant; And this Judge having once again reviewed the materials supporting and opposing the application for an extension of time to file the within application for leave and for judicial review and the granting of leave and finding no basis to reach a different conclusion than that leading to the Order dated the 16th of April, 2007 herein: IT IS ORDERED that: An extension of time to file the Applicant's application for leave and for judicial review herein is denied.
